tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1969 年发布
description: 美能达于1969年推出的旁轴相机。配备Rokkor-PF 45mm f1.7, 6 elements in 5 groups; focus down to 0.9m (3ft)。快门速度Seiko ALA, leaf shutter with self-timer (approx. 10sec)。使用Wind lever with 220 degree throw; single full stroke or multiple short strokes。感光度25-500 ASA; 15-28 DIN。

specs.镜头: Rokkor-PF 45mm f1.7, 6 elements in 5 groups; focus down to 0.9m (3ft)
specs.快门: Seiko ALA, leaf shutter with self-timer (approx. 10sec)
specs.曝光测光: Full automatic and Shutter priority automatic exposure
specs.闪光灯: hot shoe and PC socket (at end, below rewind crank); automatic flash control--the user enters the guide number and the camera sets the aperture
specs.胶片/画幅: Wind lever with 220 degree throw; single full stroke or multiple short strokes
specs.取景器: Tinted rangefinder, bright line frame; automatic parallax correction; shutter, aperture, battery condition, and flashmatic displays
